hooks.command: echo '[dev-workflow] Session rules: (1) Log every change to CHANGELOG.md in the same turn (file:line — before→after — why — verified how). (2) Before this session ends, even if blocked/interrupted, rewrite the "## Current state" block so a fresh session can resume from it alone. (3) For non-trivial tasks apply the dev-workflow skill.'; if [ -f CHANGELOG.md ]; then echo '--- RESUME CONTEXT (CHANGELOG.md) ---'; awk '/^## Current state/{f=1} /^---$/{f=0} f' CHANGELOG.md; echo '--- Last 3 entries ---'; L=$(grep -n '^### ' CHANGELOG.md | tail -3 | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); [ -n "$L" ] && tail -n +$L CHANGELOG.md | head -40; else echo "[dev-workflow] No CHANGELOG.md in this project. FIRST ACTION: create it from ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/templates/CHANGELOG.template.md before any other work."; fi; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.py) command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff check --fix "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5 ;; *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0

if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"test"' package.json 2>/dev/null; then npm test --silent 2>&1 | tail -10; elif [ -d tests ] || ls test_*.py *_test.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v pytest >/dev/null && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -10; fi; exit 0
